campaignOptions.description: How sexual content is narrated. Mechanics always resolve in full; fade narrates before and after, never the act.

Whether acts a character does not want can resolve in the fiction. off refuses them; not_against_pc allows them among NPCs but never against the player's character; on is the grimdark setting: no consent refusals for anything the character merely does not want. In every setting a revoked stance, hard limits and the adults-only rule still refuse.

Short engine-owned mood buffs after wanted intimacy (a welcome advance, a finished scene, an imprint eased). One at a time, never stacked, at most three a day per character, and never twice for the same partner or scene on the same day. off disables them.

Engine-owned shame bite for lewd_humiliate: willpower drain and a timed Humiliated status (daily cap 3). Arousal from shame only when the ordeal (masochism) imprint is ≥1 — inhibition stays orthogonal. off disables the verb's mechanical bite.
Comma-separated content the player never wants (tags such as pregnancy, lustbrand, imprint, bondage). Always refused, in every verb.
